purpose: Public-safe release evidence ledger rendered on /intelligence. Records what was OBSERVED, when, and by which kind of check. No hostnames, service identifiers, account names or credentials. Unknown is never healthy; an observation older than freshnessDays is shown as stale and treated as unknown.

candidate.label: Draft PR #63 (consolidated Web MVP release candidate)
candidate.ciEvidence: 14/14 workflows SUCCESS at exact head 90ab30ad on 23 Nov 2026; Quality Gate run 45200601574 (7/7), MySQL 8.0/8.4 CI, synthetic browser E2E and downloaded artifact digest checks. Independently re-read 24 Nov 2026.

deployment.method: Read-only hosting API check on 24 Nov 2026: preview SUSPENDED, automatic deployment OFF. Last recorded release is from 10 Oct 2026 and is not currently being served.

layers.name: Gateway and Creator security fixes (local-slot classification, redirects, pinned endpoint profiles)
layers.evidence: Source-level provider-routing, redirect and private-beta access protections are included in the 90ab30ad CI-qualified candidate. Real deployed security posture has not been observed.

layers.name: Repository CI on the candidate
layers.evidence: At 90ab30ad, all 14 exact-head GitHub workflows succeeded, including the 7-job Quality Gate. This is source/CI verification, not hosted application readiness.

layers.name: Preview deployment serves the candidate
layers.evidence: A read-only hosting check on 24 Nov confirmed the preview is suspended, automatic deployment off, with the last recorded deployment dated 10 Oct and not equal to the current candidate.
layers.blocker: Approved current-SHA deployment only after secured database preservation, schema compatibility and runtime readiness approval.

layers.name: Preview database inspected and migrated
layers.evidence: Read-only Aiven evidence on 24 Nov reports the shared free MySQL service powered off with provider-managed backups; no encrypted off-platform export, independently restored database or applied migration-journal inspection has been qualified.
layers.blocker: Explicitly approved secure network/source-access window, complete multi-schema encrypted export, isolated restore proof and migration authority.

layers.name: Live session revocation and tenant isolation
layers.evidence: Native CI and synthetic browser cases cover session and tenant controls, but no real identity-provider, deployed two-account session revocation or cross-tenant live-browser acceptance exists.

layers.name: Malware scanner runtime and file ingestion
layers.evidence: File ingestion remains off by default; scanner contracts and simulated tests do not demonstrate an approved deployed scanner with clean, infected and unavailable-path checks.
layers.blocker: Approved live scanner integration, safe object storage, and real upload acceptance before enabling ingestion.

layers.name: Real model execution
layers.evidence: Separate Sentinel development used a genuine local model with synthetic observations, but no hosted Web MVP model runtime, Tamil semantic quality or production service acceptance has been established.
layers.blocker: Independent model-quality and authenticated hosted inference qualification with approved zero-spend configuration.

layers.name: Paid Creator generation
layers.evidence: Provider authorization, spend limits and Creator safety controls are in source and tested in CI; live paid-provider operation is disabled and no approved end-to-end paid rendering exists.
layers.blocker: Separate owner authorization, cost cap, provider evidence and rights-cleared media before any paid activation.

layers.name: Request limits shared across instances
layers.evidence: Repository source includes shared MySQL request-limit controls with CI and database integration tests; no deployed multi-instance rate limiter or actual failure recovery has been verified.

layers.name: Production environment
layers.evidence: No owner-approved production release, qualified production runtime or signed deployment evidence is recorded in the current release gates. CI infrastructure mocks do not supply this.
layers.blocker: Complete preview acceptance first, then explicit owner approval and cost/security review for production infrastructure.

layers.name: Built-artifact identity
layers.evidence: The 90ab30ad release archive contained 399 non-manifest files; complete artifact, client and server SHA-256 digests matched its retained manifest and no unexpected hidden file was found. Hosted build identity remains unverified.

layers.name: Security-qualified rollback
layers.evidence: CI-qualified rollback policy rejects the older deployed commit as below the security baseline; no current approved live target or real rollback-and-restore drill has passed.
layers.blocker: Backup/restore approval, a security-qualified deployed target and observed release/health/readiness checks after controlled rollback.
